stem.text: What correctly describes the significance of the increase of the red blood cell count of humans who move from living at low altitude to high altitude?

A.text: After a few weeks at high altitude, the number of red blood cells increases to compensate for the lower availability of oxygen in the air.

B.text: At high altitude, the bone marrow produces more red blood cells to provide binding sites for the increased number of oxygen molecules available.

C.text: At high concentrations of oxygen in the blood, a cytokine stimulates the production of red blood cells to increase the oxygen-carrying capacity of the blood.

D.text: After only a few days at high altitude the number of red blood cells increases considerably to compensate for the lower availability of oxygen in the air.
